verdicts.reason: Both candidates are the same stacked layout and both look broken. The top-left beige block floats with an odd notched shape, the pool photo is shrunk to a small crop in the top-right corner, and 'Construction' runs almost into the right edge. A also drops the bottom beige accent, which leaves about a third of the canvas as dead white space. B keeps that bottom-right beige block as a bleed accent, the way the original does, so the empty lower area weighs a little less, but the bottom half still looks lopsided and unresolved.
